profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Beck Technology Ltd
profile.summary:
I have worked as a software engineer on a wide range of projects from code generation software, Telecommunications OA&M, an optical network planner, and telephony features on IP Phones. My strength lies in my ability to learn new technologies quickly, strong debugging skills, and pride in getting the job done right. I am seeking a role where I can challenge myself and use my skills to the fullest.

Specialties:
Android,
C#,
VB.NET,
JAVA,
SQL,
C++,
XML,

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software Engineer developing business automation solutions for the hospitality industry using any technology necessary to get the job done but mostly focusing on C#/VB and SQL Server.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
10/2006 - 9/2013
Designed and develope new features for IP Phones using JAVA and Android OS.

6/2001 – 10/2006
Designed and implemented new software features for the CTC(Cisco Transport Controller).

6/2000 – 6/2001
Developed GUI for Cisco’s Optical Network Planner, a standalone Java application that runs on a Windows NT platform and allows system engineers to plan an optical mesh network.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained a Network Management application written in C++ called the BSM (Base Station Manger) as well as GUI tools written using TeleUse GUI builder/C++, Expectix, and Tcl/Tk in a UNIX OS environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained practical software applications such as commercial GUI build tools and CASE-based business application runtime APIs.
